{C:81900C00}{C:819582963A3700000000}Hey...

{C:81930100}{C:819582963B3700000000}Oh, it's you, Omega.
Sorry, but I'm busy with maintenance,
so I can't stop to talk.


{x00}

rows.en:
{C:81900C00}{C:819582963C3700000000}My FT should have been recovered.
Where is it?

{C:81900A00}{C:819582963D3700000000}Are you planning to use it to make a getaway?

{C:81900C00}{C:81958296403700000000}Is my FT usable?

{C:81900700}{C:81958296413700000000}The repairs are finished.
But I can't hand it over unless I know
what you intend to use it for.

{C:81900C00}{C:81958296423700000000}Don't worry.
You aren't the ones I'll be fighting.

{C:81900200}{C:81958296433700000000}Could it be...

{C:81900C00}{C:81958296443700000000}Don't misunderstand.
That person is not in their right mind now.

{C:81958296453700000000}{C:819782830400}Mediator{C:819782830000} is the name
of the nightmare haunting them.
I'll fight to drive it away.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296463700000000}Really?
Thank you!!

{C:81900C00}{C:81958296473700000000}But once that nightmare has been driven away,
I'll become your enemy again.
Don't forget that!




{x00}

rows.en:
{C:81902700}{C:81958296353200000000}Are you
one of the Astante II's crew?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296363200000000}Drake's army?

{C:81901A00}{C:81958296580100000000}Todd!
Todd Guinness!
What are you doing here?!

{C:81902700}{C:81958296373200000000}I was waiting for the right moment.
The right moment to join up with you.

{C:81901D00}{C:81958296393200000000}You mean you're joining us?
I don't believe it.

{C:81902700}{C:819582963A3200000000}I'm no fool, either.
Even I know what the situation is.
Is that a problem?

{C:81930100}{C:819582963B3200000000}I don't mind.
We could use more allies.

{C:81902700}{C:819582963D3200000000}I owe you one.
It's not much of a thank-you,
but I brought some Aura Battlers.



{x00}

{C:81901C00}{C:819582963E3200000000}How on earth did you get
this many Aura Battlers...

{C:81902700}{C:819582963F3200000000}That's what you call personal charm.
Well, I'm counting on you!



{x00}

rows.en:
{C:81900300}{C:81958296403200000000}Oh, big brother.
This person says she wants to join us,
but...

{C:81902B00}{C:81958296590100000000}I'm Musiy Poe.
This is not my own wish, but Lord Shot
has ordered me to join you.

{C:81901E00}{C:81958296413200000000}That Shot...
Isn't he plotting something?

{C:81902B00}{C:819582965A0100000000}Don't insult him!
Lord Shot always looks ahead
when he acts.

{C:819582965C0100000000}Someone as ordinary as you could never understand.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296423200000000}What should we do, big brother?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296433200000000}I suppose we can let her join for now.
There are no guarantees, though.
Same as always.




{x00}

rows.en:
{C:81902900}{C:81958296443200000000}Are you a member of the Astante II's crew?

{C:81900400}{C:81958296453200000000}Yes, I am. What can I do for you?

{C:81902900}{C:81958296463200000000}I am the Black Knight.
I conceal my face because it bears an ugly scar.
I ask for your understanding.

{C:81900400}{C:81958296473200000000}And what brings you here,
Black Knight?

{C:81902900}{C:81958296483200000000}I would like you to take me aboard your ship.
I have a small score
to settle with Binzvanker.

{C:81958296493200000000}What say you?

{C:81930100}{C:819582964A3200000000}Anyone willing to fight alongside us
is more than welcome.
Um...

{C:81902900}{C:819582964B3200000000}I discarded my name when I concealed my face.
I would therefore have you call me the Black Knight.

{C:81930100}{C:819582964C3200000000}Well then, Black Knight,
please take your luggage
to the Astante II at the airport.

{C:81902900}{C:819582964D3200000000}Understood.






{x00}

rows.en:
{C:81905900}{C:81958296533200000000}I slipped away from Posaydal's ship
and have been waiting for you,
Daba Myroad.

{C:81905300}{C:81958296553200000000}What do you mean by that, Gablae?

{C:81905900}{C:81958296573200000000}I don't like being used
by these Claudians however they please.
There's no chance of promotion, either.

{C:81958296593200000000}I don't like having that devil around,
but Binzvanker
I dislike even mooore!!

{C:81930100}{C:819582965B3200000000}In that case,
welcome aboard, Gablae.




{x00}

{C:81930100}{C:819582965C3200000000}What's this?
The door's unlocked...

{C:81906301}{C:819582965D3200000000}You're late.

{C:81930100}{C:819582965E3200000000}Waaah!
What are you doing in my house?!

{C:81906301}{C:819582965F3200000000}Arma asked me
to provide you with support.
I'm joining you as of now.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296603200000000}Uh... pleased to have you.


{x00}

rows.en:
{C:81908900}{C:819582967D3A00000000}Still, I never imagined I'd be fighting
alongside you, Yazan Gable.

{C:81909400}{C:819582967E3A00000000}The feeling's mutual.
Why the hell should I be happy about
having to join forces with AEUG?

{C:81905002}{C:819582967F3A00000000}What odd things you say,
considering we're already working together.

{C:81909400}{C:81958296803A00000000}What was that?!
Are you picking a fight with me, bastard?!

{C:8190DC00}{C:81958296823A00000000}Hey, hey, what are you arguing about?
We've got the same objective right now.

{C:81958296843A00000000}In that sense, we all belong
to the Astante II.
Am I wrong?

{C:81908900}{C:81958296853A00000000}Hmm, that makes sense.
You're quite right, Gregore.

{C:81909400}{C:81958296863A00000000}For now, at least...
Yeah, that's how it is.

{C:81905002}{C:81958296873A00000000}(Why do they keep repeating
the obvious?
I don't understand people from other continents.)



{x00}

{C:8190FE01}{C:81958296610100000000}Did you say somethiiing?!

{C:81930100}{C:819582968A3300000000}No, nothing at all.

{C:819582968B3300000000}(Time to go, time to go.)

{C:81930100}{C:81958296E93300000000}What's all the commotion?

{C:8193B901}{C:81958296EA3300000000}Beautiful young lady,
please,
accept this rose.

{C:8193FF01}{C:81958296EB3300000000}You're giving me a rose?
Really, truly?!

{C:8193B901}{C:81958296EC3300000000}Indeed. I give roses
only to beautiful people.

{C:8193FD01}{C:81958296ED3300000000}Hey, get away from Rag!!
Don't go near her!!

{C:8193FE01}{C:819582966A0100000000}Why?! Why Rag?!
What about me is
inferior to heeer?!!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296EE3300000000}That's even more trouble.
Well, let's just call it
communication. Yes.



{x00}

{C:8193B701}{C:81958296053400000000}What, you can't even drink?
Still just a boy, huh?
Then I bet you don't know a thing about women, either.

{C:81935900}{C:81958296063400000000}Th-th-th-th-th-th-that's not true!
There are plenty of women
I'm close to. Lots of them!

{C:8193B701}{C:81958296073400000000}I'd feel a lot more at ease
if the Chibodee Gals were here with me, too.
Let's take it easy, my frieeend.





{x00}

come your way?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296083300000000}What's wrong?

{C:81930300}{C:81958296093300000000}Gambaruger and Raijin-Oh

{C:81909302}{C:819582960C3300000000}Tch, don't boss us around!

{C:81909502}{C:819582960D3300000000}Let's hurry up,

let's head baaack to the Astante II!!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296113300000000}Rie, can you hear me?

{C:81930300}{C:81958296123300000000}Yes, Rie here.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296133300000000}The Defense Class and Ganba Team

Guess what they were doing?

{C:81930300}{C:81958296143300000000}What were those kids doing?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296153300000000}They were taking a commemorative photo.

{C:81930300}{C:81958296163300000000}What...?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296183300000000}So, that's the story.
